info.name: Nexos AI Public API Production Agent Management Files API

params.name: after
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 10,000, and the default is 10,000.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order by the created_at timestamp of the objects. asc for ascending order and desc for descending order.

params.name: purpose
params.description: Only return files with the given purpose.

items.docs: Return the list of files that have been uploaded.
Upload a file that other endpoints can reference, such as the request file consumed by the Batch API.

params.name: file_id
params.description: The ID of the file to use for this request.

items.docs: Return the metadata for a single file by its ID.
Permanently delete a single file by its ID.
Download the raw contents of a single file by its ID.
